topic: action overlay selection cursor, availability gate and selected-cell blink

source.address_space: DOS LE loader flat linear; not file offsets

functions.role: initial selection = first direction whose availability word is zero
direction/confirm/cancel input; a direction is accepted only when its availability word is zero
key wait loop; toggles the selected-cell blink phase and calls sub_179D5 each iteration
steady overlay redraw; adds the blink phase to the selected direction's cell index
battle action wrapper; builds the availability table then dispatches on the selected direction

globals.role: selected direction index 0..3 (up, left, right, down)
BIOS low-word timestamp of the last blink toggle
BIOS timer low word sampled by sub_17898

conclusions.statement: The steady overlay draws cell 3*first_table[d] + 2*second_table[d] for every direction, and adds [0x53c13] for the direction equal to [0x53c57].

[0x53c13] alternates between 0 and 1 whenever the BIOS low word at 0x46c has advanced by more than 3 ticks (or moved backwards) since [0x53c17]; the timestamp is then refreshed. One BIOS tick is 1193182/65536 Hz, so the alternation period is 4 ticks, about 219.7 ms.
Scan codes 0x48/0x4b/0x4d/0x50 write [0x53c57] only when the availability word for that direction is zero; otherwise the selection is unchanged and the loop keeps waiting.
sub_173E7 sets [0x53c57] to the first index 0..3 whose availability word is zero, stopping at 4 when every action is unavailable.
sub_177FC is called by 0x16f55, 0x1728c, 0x18d8c, 0x19df7 and 0x1bbdc, so the blink and the availability gate belong to every overlay chooser, not only the battle action menu.

not_claimed: The battle availability producers themselves (0x1b8a6, 0x1c269, unit+0x27) are unchanged by this export.
No screen anchor, animation duration or same-state pixel comparison is claimed here.
